name: patient_has_undergone_surgical_procedure_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a surgical procedure.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a surgical procedure at any time in their history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a surgical procedure at any time in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a surgical procedure.

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the surgical procedure was performed in Edmonton, Alberta.
